tagline: Watch faces for Wear OS and apps for Garmin watches.

garmin.name: Strength
garmin.intro: A gym set logger for Garmin watches. Pick a program, lift, press OK: the set is logged and the rest timer starts. Works offline, with no account and no companion app.
images: Strength rest timer on the bezel
Next set with weight, reps and last session
Workout menu: undo, +30 s rest, skip
features: One press per set: OK logs the weight and reps and starts the rest
Rest countdown on the bezel, with vibration, sound and a heads-up before it ends
Four ready-made programs plus four of your own, edited on the watch or the phone
121 exercises by muscle group, plus 12 custom exercises
Weight suggestions from your last session, one step heavier when you hit every rep
Personal records, workout history and progress charts on the watch
You choose what syncs to Garmin Connect
Eight accent colours, 34 languages, round, square and two-colour displays
garmin.requires: Garmin watches with Connect IQ 3.2 or newer: Forerunner, fēnix, epix, Enduro, Instinct, Venu, vívoactive, MARQ, Descent, D2 and Approach models

faces.name: Relief
faces.intro: A milled digital watch face for Wear OS. Large time, deep pockets for your data, and a surface you choose.
images: Relief always-on display, dimmed with frames
features: 8 complication slots: any data from any app on your watch
Built-in weather, UV index, chance of rain, today's high and low, or nothing at all in empty fields
7 accent colours and 10 surfaces: brushed, sunburst, perlage, Côtes de Genève, carbon and more
Hour colour, plate tint and rim marks
